question: Which of the following word is the SYNONYM of the word **'hegemonic'** used in the passage?
solution: The correct answer is **"Supremacy."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Hegemonic'** means having or exercising power and control over others. (आधिपत्‍य-विषयक) • **Exampl****e:** *The **hegemonic**__ rule of the king was challenged by the rebellion.* • Synonym of **'hegemonic'** is** 'supremacy'.** • **'Supremacy'** means the state or condition of being superior to all others in authority, power, or status. (अधिकार में सर्वोच्चता की स्थिति) __ • **Example:** *He approved the **supremacy**__ of a strong federal government over the demands of states.* • So, the correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Pall"** means to become dull or uninteresting. (कम रोचक या कम महत्व का हो जाना) • **"Tire"** means to become exhausted or fatigued. (आराम या नींद की ज़रूरत महसूस होना, थकावट होना, थकना; किसी को थकाना) • **"Weary"** means to become tired or worn out. (थका-माँदा (विशेषतः किसी काम को देर तक करते रहने के कारण)) 1bc:T500,The correct answer is **"August 1990."**
